port.description: TCP port on which the httptunnel server listens for incoming connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

tunnel_dir.description: Directory path used to store files when file forwarding is enabled (i.e., not in pure tunnel mode).

forward_files.description: Whether to forward files to clients instead of creating a raw TCP tunnel. Set to false for transparent tunneling.

bind_interface.description: Optional IP address or network interface name to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or 'eth0'). Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for secure communication. Requires certificate and key paths if enabled.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

http_headers.description: List of custom HTTP headers to include in responses (e.g., for CORS, security headers, or debugging).

upload_rate.description: Maximum upload rate per client (bytes per second), e.g., 1 MiB/s.

download_rate.description: Maximum download rate per client (bytes per second), e.g., 5 MiB/s.
